'''Rev Terrel''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] with [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]], specifically [[Special Threats Division]]. As an Intelligence agent, one of Terrel's assignments was to review the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].
